claim_boundary: HMDB51's broad action class mixes sport fencing, historical/rapier practice, stage combat, and film scenes. It supports generic action-recognition stress tests, not modern three-weapon labels, athlete evaluation, or bout analysis. Kaggle's dataset-level MIT label does not establish rights for each source clip, so extracted media remains local research material.
